15330-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.creator: Unknown

46332-merrie-england-in-the-olden-time-v.description: A book by George Daniel. at Edinburgh in 1683, gives a curious picture of London tradesmen, &c. Robin goes to Court, but receives cold welcome; thence to Westminster Hall. "It were no great matter," quoth the lawyers, "if Conscience quite were knock'd on the head.

Some computations have been done with resour
arxiv-2101-06126.creator: Daniel Obraczka, Jonathan Schuchart, Erhard Rahm
arxiv-2101-06126.description: Abstract Entity Resolution (ER) is a constitutional part for integrating different knowledge graphs in order to identify entities referring to the same real-world object. A promising approach is the use of graph embeddings for ER in order to determine the similarity of entities based on the similarity of their graph neighborhood.

arxiv-2303-00421.title: Operator-difference schemes on non-uniform grids for second-order evolutionary equations Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2303-00421.creator: P.N. Vabishchevich
arxiv-2303-00421.description: Abstract The approximate solution of the Cauchy problem for second-order evolution equations is performed, first of all, using three-level time approximations. Such approximations are easily constructed and relatively uncomplicated to investigate when using uniform time grids. When solving applied problems numerically, we should focus on approximations with variable time steps.

arxiv-2310-05808.title: An Open-Loop Baseline for Reinforcement Learning Locomotion Tasks
arxiv-2310-05808.creator: Antonin Raffin, Olivier Sigaud, Jens Kober, Alin Albu-Schäffer, João Silvério & Freek Stulp
arxiv-2310-05808.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Antonin Raffin, Olivier Sigaud, Jens Kober, Alin Albu-Schäffer, João Silvério & Freek Stulp. In search of a simple baseline for Deep Reinforcement Learning in locomotion tasks, we propose a model-free open-loop strategy. By leveraging prior knowledge and the elegance of simple oscillators to generate periodic joint motions, it achieves respectable performance in five different locomotion environments, with a number of tunable parameters that is a tiny fraction of the thousands typically required by DRL algorithms.

arxiv-2401-03036.title: Modelling and calibration of pair-rule protein patterns in Drosophila embryo: From Even-skipped and Fushi-tarazu to Wingless expression networks
arxiv-2401-03036.creator: Catarina Dias, Rui Dilão
arxiv-2401-03036.description: Abstract We modelled and calibrated the distributions of the seven-stripe patterns of Even-skipped ( Eve ) and Fushi-tarazu ( Ftz ) pair-rule proteins along the anteroposterior axis of the Drosphila embryo, established during early development. We have identified the putative repressive combinations for five Eve enhancers, and we have explored the relationship between Eve and Ftz for complementary patterns.

arxiv-2402-01330.title: Video Semantic Communication with Major Object Extraction and Contextual Video Encoding Thanks: This work was supported in part by Beijing Natural Science Foundation under Grant L223027, in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grants 61671086 and 61629101, supported by Nati
arxiv-2402-01330.creator: Haopeng Li 1, Haonan Tong 1, Sihua Wang 1, Nuocheng Yang 1, Zhaohui Yang 2, Changchuan Yin 1
arxiv-2402-01330.description: Abstract This paper studies an end-to-end video semantic communication system for massive communication. In the considered system, the transmitter must continuously send the video to the receiver to facilitate character reconstruction in immersive applications, such as interactive video conference. However, transmitting the original video information with substantial amounts of data poses a challenge to the limited wireless resources.

arxiv-2408-00133.title: Ergotropy and capacity optimization in Heisenberg spin-chain quantum batteries
arxiv-2408-00133.creator: Asad Ali, Saif Al-Kuwari, M. I. Hussain, Tim Byrnes, M. T. Rahim, James Q. Quach, Mehrdad Ghominejad, Saeed Haddadi

arxiv-2409-06013.title: Improved Visually Prompted Keyword Localisation in Real Low-Resource Settings Thanks: This work was supported in part by European Union’s Horizon research and innovation program under grant agreement no. 101070190 (AI4Trust).
arxiv-2409-06013.creator: Leanne Nortje, Dan Oneață, Herman Kamper
arxiv-2409-06013.description: Abstract Given an image query, visually prompted keyword localisation (VPKL) aims to find occurrences of the depicted word in a speech collection. This can be useful when transcriptions are not available for a low-resource language (e.g. if it is unwritten).

arxiv-2409-15963.title: Provably Efficient Exploration in Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2409-15963.creator: Bo Yue, Jian Li, Guiliang Liu
arxiv-2409-15963.description: Abstract Optimizing objective functions subject to constraints is fundamental in many real-world applications. However, these constraints are often not readily defined and must be inferred from expert agent behaviors, a problem known as Inverse Constraint Inference. Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) is a common solver for recovering feasible constraints in complex environments, relying on training samples collected from interactive environments.

arxiv-2410-12928.title: DreamCraft3D++: Efficient Hierarchical 3D Generation with Multi-Plane Reconstruction Model Thanks: Jingxiang Sun, Cheng Peng, Ruizhi Shao, Xiaochen Zhao and Yebin Liu are with Department of Automation, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China. E-mail: {starkjxsun, chengpeng002, jia1saurus}@gmail.com; zha
arxiv-2410-12928.creator: Jingxiang Sun, Cheng Peng, Ruizhi Shao, Yuan-Chen Guo, Xiaochen Zhao, Yangguang Li, YanPei Cao, Bo Zhang, Yebin Liu
arxiv-2410-12928.description: Abstract We introduce DreamCraft3D++, an extension of DreamCraft3D that enables efficient high-quality generation of complex 3D assets. DreamCraft3D++ inherits the multi-stage generation process of DreamCraft3D, but replaces the time-consuming geometry sculpting optimization with a feed-forward multi-plane based reconstruction model, speeding up the process by 1000x.

arxiv-2506-15914.title: On the Exceptional Sets of Transcendental Analytic Functions in Several Variables with Integer Coefficients
arxiv-2506-15914.creator: Jean Lelis, Bruno De Paula Miranda, CARLOS GUSTAVO MOREIRA
arxiv-2506-15914.description: Abstract . In 2020, Marques and Moreira proved that every subset of ℚ ¯ ∩ B ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \overline{\mathbb{Q}}\cap B(0,1) , which is closed under complex conjugation and contains 0 0 , is the exceptional set of uncountably many transcendental analytic functions with integer coefficients.

arxiv-2507-17643.title: Arithmetic Degrees are Cohomological Lyapunov Multipliers
arxiv-2507-17643.creator: Jiarui Song, Junyi Xie, She Yang
arxiv-2507-17643.description: Abstract . For endomorphisms of projective varieties, we prove that the arithmetic degree of a point with Zariski dense orbit must be a cohomological Lyapunov multiplier of the dynamical system. We will apply our result to deduce a corollary towards the dynamical Mordell–Lang conjecture. 1.

arxiv-2512-22696.title: Tiling Triangles With 2 ​ π / 3 2\pi/3 Angles
arxiv-2512-22696.creator: Yan X Zhang
arxiv-2512-22696.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yan X Zhang. Motivated by a question of Erdös and inquiries by Beeson and Laczkovich, we explore the possible N N for which a triangle T T can tile into N N congruent copies of a triangle R R . The reptile cases (where T T is similar to R R ) and the commensurable-angles cases (where all angles of R R are rational multiples of π \pi ) are well-understood.

pmc-10796203.creator: Anusha Manoharan, Megat Muhammad Haris Megat Zainal, Beh Hooi Chin, Koh Wen Ming, Zamzurina Asmuee, Norafini Salamon, Peter Jerampang, Radhiyah Hussin, Nadia Hamimah Kamaludin, Chandrashekhar T Sreeramareddy
pmc-10796203.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to assess menopause symptoms, treatment-seeking behaviors, treatments received, and factors associated with seeking consultation from healthcare providers (HCPs).MethodsUsing a self-administered Menopause Quick-6 in the Malay language (MQ6[M]) questionnaire, we surveyed 349 women aged 40–60 years attending primary healthcare clinics in four states in Malaysia for their menopause symptoms.

pmc-11496382.title: Love thy neighbour: Feral buffalos show greater space use, resource overlap and encounters during the wet season in the Northern Territory
pmc-11496382.creator: Kyana N. Pike, Justin Perry, Eric Vanderduys, John P. Y. Arnould, Andrew Hoskins
pmc-11496382.description: Managing feral water buffalo in the Northern Territory is a formidable challenge. As an introduced species, buffalo are associated with a myriad of biosecurity, economic, cultural and environmental issues ranging from overgrazing, decreased water quality, disease vectors to the destruction of cultural assets. Nevertheless, the buffalo are also a harvestable resource that can support economic development of the region.

pmc-11565527.title: PEGylated Elesclomol@Cu(Ⅱ)-based Metal‒organic framework with effective nanozyme performance and cuproptosis induction efficacy for enhanced PD-L1-based immunotherapy
pmc-11565527.creator: Xufeng Lu, Wenhai Deng, Shuaibin Wang, Shengsheng Zhao, Bingzi Zhu, Binglong Bai, Yiwen Mao, Ji Lin, Yongdong Yi, Zuoliang Xie, Xiang Wang, Yongyong Lu, Xiufeng Huang, Tao You, Xiaolei Chen, Weijian Sun, Xian Shen
pmc-11565527.description: Nanozymes constitute a promising treatment strategy for antitumor therapy. However, the catalytic function of metal‒organic framework (MOF)-based nanozymes during cuproptosis remains unclear. In this study, a Cu(Ⅱ)-based MOF nanocomposite loaded with the copper ionophore elesclomol and surface modified with polyethylene glycol polymer (PEG) was developed (ES@Cu(Ⅱ)-MOF) for effective cuproptosis induction.

pmc-11603733.title: Changes in tobacco and alcohol consumption during the COVID-19 pandemic in India: a propensity score matching approach
pmc-11603733.creator: Amit Summan, Ramanan Laxminarayan
pmc-11603733.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesThe COVID-19 pandemic may have influenced alcohol and tobacco consumption in low-income and middle-income countries, yet the effects are relatively unknown. In this study, we estimated the medium-term effects of the pandemic on tobacco and alcohol consumption in India.MethodsWe used data from the fifth round of the National Family Health Survey 2019–2021, a nationally representative survey conducted between June 2019 and April 2021.

pmc-11690108.title: ASSOCIATION BETWEEN POLYPHARMACY AND Α-KLOTHO IN US OLDER ADULTS: THE MEDIATION ROLE OF INFLAMMATORY MARKERS
pmc-11690108.creator: Kai Wei, Chun Chen, Yanping Yang, Libin Wang, Shuimei Sun
pmc-11690108.description: IntroductionPolypharmacy may lead to adverse health outcomes in older adults, but the relationship between polypharmacy and accelerated aging is not well understood. This study aims to investigate the association between polypharmacy and α-klotho, a blood anti-aging protein, using large population-based data.

pmc-13412861.title: Comparison of VISUMAX 800 and VISUMAX 500 Femtosecond Laser Systems for Myopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13412861.creator: Qi Wan, Ran Wei, Li Chen, Ke Ma
pmc-13412861.description: Objectives: The VISUMAX 800 (Carl Zeiss Meditec) is the second-generation femtosecond laser for small incision lenticule extraction (SMILE), featuring faster pulse rates, automated cyclotorsion compensation (OcuLign), and automated centration (CentraLign) versus the VISUMAX 500. This systematic review and meta-analysis compared their clinical outcomes in myopia correction.

pmc-13536217.title: Identifying Eating Disorders in Adolescents and Adults Living With Higher Weight: An Updated Systematic Review of Questionnaire Diagnostic Accuracy
pmc-13536217.creator: Eve T House, Caitlin M McMaster, Natalie B Lister, Isabelle R Jardine, Sasha J Lorien, Anna Lene Seidler, Hiba Jebeile
pmc-13536217.description: ObjectiveTo update the evidence regarding the diagnostic accuracy of eating disorder (ED) questionnaires in adolescents and adults with higher weight.MethodFive databases were systematically searched from 2020 to November 2025 (CRD420251186115). Included studies reported on the diagnostic accuracy of self‐report questionnaires against a clinical interview to identify EDs and disordered eating behaviors (DEBs) in adolescents and adults with higher weight.
